r01.binding_paraphrase: unrestrained indulgence given so much latitude that it runs toward total collapse and self-destruction
r01.liberating_paraphrase: disciplined restraint that holds form, containing the dissolving tendency rather than letting it destroy everything

r02.binding_paraphrase: the swollen sense of being the sole doer, taking oneself as the one controlling everything
r02.liberating_paraphrase: acting and functioning effectively without inflating the self or claiming to be the sole doer

r03.binding_paraphrase: a hypnotic entrancement that suspends common sense and discernment under the grip of a deluded obsession
r03.liberating_paraphrase: withdrawing the mind from that spell into clear discernment along an upright path, no longer entranced

r04.binding_paraphrase: the sting of resentment at another's success, covetous ill-feeling toward someone else's good fortune
r04.liberating_paraphrase: sympathetic gladness at another's good fortune, rejoicing in others' success rather than being pained by it

r05.binding_paraphrase: rigid over-holding that clings to one's position and resists any movement toward subtlety
r05.liberating_paraphrase: being settled in one's true stance, the sustaining principle, an unbroken movement toward subtlety and ultimate merger

r06.binding_paraphrase: cruelty toward the weak, inflicting physical harm, with crude and cruel thought and behaviour
r06.liberating_paraphrase: compassion that protects the vulnerable, the wish to lessen another's misery and awaken their latent capacity

r07.binding_paraphrase: self-doubt that cannot commit, wavering lack of confidence and distrust of oneself and others
r07.liberating_paraphrase: steady confidence to commit and rely, trust in oneself, in others and in the path

r08.binding_paraphrase: perverse reactive irritability discharged at others, taking offence at kindness and turning contrary under provocation
r08.liberating_paraphrase: forbearance that absorbs provocation, an even, unreactive temper that does not discharge its irritation

r09.binding_paraphrase: restless striving compulsively driven on, unable to cease, endlessly reaching outward toward worldly ends
r09.liberating_paraphrase: purposeful effort applied to rouse dormant higher potential, then resting into alert repose without inertia

r10.binding_paraphrase: worldly desire and longing, grasping for wealth, opulence, name, fame and social position, pulled toward the crude
r10.liberating_paraphrase: physical longing sublimated and redirected toward the higher aim of liberation, with worldly grasping released

r11.binding_paraphrase: neglect and disregard of what truly has value, indifference misapplied so that genuine worth goes unattended
r11.liberating_paraphrase: regard that recognizes and attends to genuine worth, reserving indifference only for the truly unacceptable

r12.binding_paraphrase: partial, possessive attachment bounded by time, place and individuality, clinging to one's own while excluding or even harming what lies outside it
r12.liberating_paraphrase: affection expanded past those boundaries into universal love that holds the loved one on an open hand

r13.binding_paraphrase: anxious rumination, the mind churning over unresolved possibilities and personal consequences, gripping every worried what-if
r13.liberating_paraphrase: composed, impersonal reflection that holds an unsettled situation open without forcing premature closure or anxious grip

r14.binding_paraphrase: clarity, purity or harmony clung to as superiority or attachment, a subtle golden chain of attainment
r14.liberating_paraphrase: unqualified liberation in which clarity is realized without any attachment to that clarity itself

r15.binding_paraphrase: fixation on the manifest, physically visible, outward-facing world of appearances
r15.liberating_paraphrase: inner, subtle seeing and knowing, an intuitional vision turned within

r16.binding_paraphrase: grasping, clinging hope goaded toward a specific outcome, the downward pull of attached desire
r16.liberating_paraphrase: forward-looking hope held without attachment, acting while releasing the grip on the result

r17.binding_paraphrase: possessive acquisition, worldly purpose pursued and held as gain, status or control, grasping to acquire
r17.liberating_paraphrase: purposeful action directed to legitimate ends without possessive clinging to what is acquired
